policy: greedy argmax (eps=0); 10 rollouts, seeds 0-9, random start positions (overcooked random_start_pos)
tick_rate_note: web/game.js L3: tick every 250ms (4 ticks/s), timer -1s every 4 ticks, AI partner acts every 3 ticks (~1.33 steps/s), pot cooks 20 ticks. So 60s = 240 game ticks but only 80 partner steps. Reported at 80 (web partner pace), 240 (web tick count) and 400 (overcooked default horizon).
observation: Greedy policy is deterministic and converges to the same cycle regardless of start, so min=max. Kai with a STAY partner delivers 0 soups at every horizon (the trained policy relies on Wendy).

web_pace_80_steps.rationale: child+Kai should match the trained pair (2) at web pace; 1 soup = partial credit since Kai alone makes 0

browser_L4.note: Measured in the web game (headless Chromium), 60 s = 240 ticks, Kai acts every 3rd tick (80 steps), overcooked pot rules in L4 (empty-hand interact starts cooking any 1-3 onion soup, 20 Kai-steps cook). Kai = trained soup_shaped s7 net (web/kai.js, greedy, agent 1). 10 runs = 5 Wendy start cells x 2 facings. 'rule_1_3' = rule planner Wendy at Kai's pace, 'rule_4_3' = every tick (child-like speed), 'net_1_3' = trained Wendy net (agent 0).
browser_L4.threshold_check: Kai-net + trained Wendy in browser = 2 (identical to Python at 80 steps); Kai-net + rule Wendy mean 2.6 (min 2) at Kai pace, 2.2 (min 1) at 4 steps/s; Kai alone = 0. Win >= 2 stays sensible; 1 = partial.
